audio.text: How did it go when you asked for an extension on your essay?

options: I went there by bus early this morning.
She gave me until Monday, so I can breathe again.
The essay has to be at least three thousand words long.
Yes, I asked her right after class.

why.en: "How did it go" → the result; "I can breathe again" shows relief. A repeats "go" literally; D answers a how-question with "Yes".
why.tr: "How did it go" → sonuç; "I can breathe again" rahatladığını gösteriyor. A "go" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla tekrar ediyor; D "nasıl" sorusuna "Yes" ile cevap veriyor.
why.es: "How did it go" → el resultado; "I can breathe again" muestra alivio. A repite "go" en sentido literal; D responde "Yes" a una pregunta de "cómo".
